## Overview

This report runs the **Jackknife+ Predictive Inference** project end-to-end in Julia (based on Barber et al., 2021). It executes your scripts in order:

1. **`JackknifePlus.jl`**: Loads the fast rank-1 OLS leave-one-out implementation.
2. **`Test.jl`**: Verifies mathematical accuracy against naive refitting and checks empirical coverage.
3. **`BenchmarkTools.jl`**: Measures runtime speedups across small-to-medium synthetic datasets.
4. **`benchmark_msd.jl`**: Evaluates predictive intervals and scaling on the `YearPredictionMSD` dataset.

---

```{julia}
using Plots

# Collect benchmark results across sample sizes
ns = [50, 100, 200, 400, 800]
p, m = 5, 20
times_naive = Float64[]
times_fast  = Float64[]

for n in ns
    X_tr = randn(n, p)
    y_tr = X_tr * ones(p) .+ randn(n)
    X_te = randn(m, p)

    # Measure median time in milliseconds
    t_n = @elapsed predict_naive_loo(X_tr, y_tr, X_te; alpha=0.10)
    t_f = @elapsed begin
        mod = fit_jackknife_plus(X_tr, y_tr; fit_intercept=true)
        predict_intervals(mod, X_te; alpha=0.10)
    end

    push!(times_naive, t_n * 1000)
    push!(times_fast,  t_f * 1000)
end

plot(ns, times_naive,
    label = "Naive LOO Refit O(n²p²)",
    marker = :circle,
    linewidth = 2,
    xscale = :log10,
    yscale = :log10,
    xlabel = "Training Sample Size (n)",
    ylabel = "Execution Time (ms, log scale)",
    title = "Jackknife+ Computational Scaling",
    legend = :topleft,
    grid = true
)

plot!(ns, times_fast,
    label = "Fast Rank-1 OLS O(np² + p³)",
    marker = :diamond,
    linewidth = 2
)
```

include("BenchmarkTools.jl")

```{julia}
alphas = [0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30]
emp_covs = Float64[]

for a in alphas
    hits = 0
    for _ in 1:300
        X_tr = randn(40, 3)
        y_tr = X_tr * [1.5, -1.0, 0.5] .+ randn(40)
        X_te = randn(1, 3)
        y_te = (X_te * [1.5, -1.0, 0.5])[1] + randn()

        mod = fit_jackknife_plus(X_tr, y_tr)
        ci = predict_intervals(mod, X_te; alpha=a)
        hits += (ci[1, 1] <= y_te <= ci[1, 2])
    end
    push!(emp_covs, hits / 300)
end

plot(1.0 .- alphas, emp_covs,
    label = "Observed Empirical Coverage",
    marker = :circle,
    linewidth = 2,
    xlabel = "Nominal Target Coverage (1 - α)",
    ylabel = "Empirical Coverage Rate",
    title = "Distribution-Free Coverage Verification",
    xlims = (0.68, 0.97),
    ylims = (0.35, 1.0),
    legend = :topleft
)

# Reference lines: Ideal (1 - alpha) and Theoretical Lower Bound (1 - 2*alpha)
plot!(1.0 .- alphas, 1.0 .- alphas, label = "Nominal Target (1 - α)", linestyle = :dash, color = :gray)
plot!(1.0 .- alphas, 1.0 .- 2.0 .* alphas, label = "Theoretical Floor (1 - 2α)", linestyle = :dot, color = :red, linewidth = 2)
```

```{julia}
# Take first 60 test points from YearPredictionMSD evaluation
k = 60
y_sub = y_test_sub[1:k]
low_sub = intervals[1:k, 1]
high_sub = intervals[1:k, 2]
mid_sub = (low_sub .+ high_sub) ./ 2.0

# Identify points inside vs outside the interval
inside = (y_sub .>= low_sub) .& (y_sub .<= high_sub)

# Plot interval bars using error bars around the midpoint
p_intervals = plot(1:k, mid_sub,
    yerror = (mid_sub .- low_sub, high_sub .- mid_sub),
    seriestype = :scatter,
    markersize = 2,
    color = :steelblue,
    alpha = 0.6,
    label = "90% Jackknife+ Interval",
    xlabel = "Test Song Index",
    ylabel = "Release Year",
    title = "YearPredictionMSD: Predictive Intervals vs. Ground Truth"
)

# Overlay ground-truth points (green = covered, red = missed)
scatter!(p_intervals, findall(inside), y_sub[inside], color = :green, markersize = 4, label = "Covered (In Interval)")
scatter!(p_intervals, findall(.!inside), y_sub[.!inside], color = :red, marker = :xcross, markersize = 6, label = "Missed (Out of Interval)")
```

# Recompute leverage scores from fitted MSD model
h_scores = [dot(view(model.X_train, i, :), model.XtX_inv * view(model.X_train, i, :)) for i in 1:model.n]

# Sample 2,000 points for a clean scatter plot
sample_idx = rand(1:model.n, 2000)

scatter(h_scores[sample_idx], model.residuals_loo[sample_idx],
    alpha = 0.35,
    markersize = 3,
    color = :purple,
    xlabel = "Leverage Score (hᵢᵢ)",
    ylabel = "Absolute LOO Residual |yᵢ - ŷ₋ᵢ(xᵢ)| (Years)",
    title = "Influence of Leverage on LOO Residuals (YearPredictionMSD)",
    legend = false
)
